description: This Java source file defines an exception handler class 'ApiExceptionHandler' using Spring's @RestControllerAdvice to catch specific exceptions related to promotions and map them to appropriate HTTP responses. It standardizes error responses for promotion-related errors such as coupon not found, inactive coupons, currency mismatch, invalid requests, and a general handler for unexpected exceptions.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring component that handles exceptions thrown during API request processing related to promotions, converting them into HTTP responses with standardized error messages.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles CouponNotFoundException, returns 404 with an error response.

methods.name: handleInactive
methods.description: Handles CouponInactiveException, returns 422 with an error response.

methods.name: handleCurrencyMismatch
methods.description: Handles CurrencyMismatchException, returns 422 with an error response.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles InvalidApplyRequestException, returns 400 with an error response.

methods.name: handleUnexpected
methods.description: Handles generic Exception, returns 500 with a generic error message.
